home.body: I am Aarón, a developer focused on creating structured and scalable solutions. I believe in code written with patience, where every line has a purpose and every system is built with care.

about-me.title: About Me
about-me.path: My journey in web development is defined by self-reflection. I constantly seek different perspectives to create code that is not only functional, but also sustainable, understandable, and practical, always following the best practices of every tool.
about-me.hobbies: I am a video game enthusiast, an environment where I put my analytical and strategic thinking to the test. This facet allows me to train the planning and organization of complex systems in a dynamic and logical way.
about-me.crochet: I complement this mindset with crochet, a hobby that reminds me of the importance of patience and calm. I have learned that when the code is not on my side, the best way to maintain focus and perseverance is to take a deep breath: great projects, much like weaving, are built calmly, stitch by stitch.

projects.title: Projects
projects.proyecto-pokemon: One of my first web applications, built using the core stack for standard web development. Refactored years later with everything I've learned since.
projects.naga: A management system designed to track FCT (vocational training internships).
projects.mongo-verba: A minimalist web application for collecting and managing personal quotes.
projects.parking-vigo: Track real-time parking availability across Vigo.

modular-architecture.title: Modular Architecture
modular-architecture.desc: Organizing code into independent pieces to ensure easier maintenance and scalability.

sustainability-review.title: Sustainability & Review
sustainability-review.desc: A focus on readability and continuous improvement to prevent technical debt.

methodical-problem-solving.title: Methodical Problem Solving
methodical-problem-solving.desc: A step-by-step approach to breaking down problems, backed by documentation and logic.

growth-mindset.title: Growth Mindset
growth-mindset.desc: Constant curiosity and the ability to research and master new tools for every challenge.

footer: Designed with logic, woven with passion.
